QT|/ms_scope/3: in the event of water-conducting cracks: initial injection of AQUAFIN-P1 to stop the ingress of water
QT|/ms_qc/0: record substrate temperature (approx. 5–30 °C) and application temperature (approx. 10–30 °C)
QT|/ms_qc/1: record batch numbers, mix ratio 1 : 1 by volume and mixing time approx. 3 minutes
QT|/ms_qc/2: grout in within the pot life of approx. 30 minutes; higher temperatures shorten the pot life
QT|/ms_qc/3: record the quantity grouted per packer; reference value approx. 1.1 kg per litre of voids
QT|/ms_qc/4: remove the packers only after the resin has cured; final curing at 20 °C approx. 5 hours
QT|/ms_hse/1: protect surfaces that are not to be treated from the effects of AQUAFIN-P4
QT|/ms_hse/2: clean tools immediately after use with suitable solvent; flash point of the cleaning agent above +21 °C
QT|/ms_hse/3: no material residues shall be allowed to dry and stick in the equipment; observe the specifications of the machine manufacturer
QT|/ms_hse/4: store frost-free, cool and dry, at 15–25 °C; promptly use opened containers

CRT|/cr.title: Concrete restoration
CRT|/cr.sub: One system from the reinforcement to the finished surface.
CRT|/cr.intro: Corrosion protection and bond coat {HSF}, repair mortar {BIS540} for breakouts of 5–40 mm, fine smoothing mortar {BIS16} for 1–6 mm, and the crystalline repair mortar {IM} where water is involved. Cement-based, one component, chloride-free.

CRT|/cr.adv.label: Advantages
CRT|/cr.adv.title: Why the system works
CRT|/cr.adv.cards/0/3: {BIS540}: concrete substitute product for static and non-static relevant restoration. Compressive strength approx. 60 N/mm² after 28 days.
CRT|/cr.adv.cards/1/3: {BIS540} according to EN 1504-3. The bond coat {HSF} is brushed down to the pores; the mortar follows wet in wet.
CRT|/cr.adv.cards/2/3: {BIS540} on large surfaces up to 20 mm in one step, in several layers up to 40 mm. {BIS16}: up to 6 mm.
CRT|/cr.adv.cards/3/3: {HSF} on the de-rusted reinforcement, second coat after approx. 2 hours. Polymer modified, saponification resistant.
CRT|/cr.adv.cards/4/3: {HSF}, {BIS540} and {BIS16} at 5–30 °C. Can be trowelled and sprayed; machine application: Technical Information No. 43.
CRT|/cr.adv.cards/5/3: Foot traffic after approx. 24 hours. A cementitious waterproofing slurry can follow after approx. 24 hours as an alternative curing method.
CRT|/cr.pictos/0/2: Pre-blended dry mortars: add water, mix approx. 3 minutes
CRT|/cr.pictos/1/2: Can be trowelled and sprayed; brush-applied bond coat
CRT|/cr.pictos/2/2: Vapour permeable, frost proof and resistant to thaw

CRT|/cr.adv.lists/0/1/2: levelling pool tank walls, modelling pool edges in swimming pools
CRT|/cr.adv.lists/0/1/3: corrosion protection for exposed and abraded reinforcement bars
CRT|/cr.adv.lists/0/1/4: watertight filling of open cracks and holes, coving mortar ({IM})

CRT|/cr.adv.lists/1/1/4: capillary active, supports self-repair of the concrete ({IM})
CRT|/cr.adv.lists/2/1/1: frost proof and resistant to thaw
